study_context.study_scope: Cost prerequisite only: 64 fresh authored complete mappings, balanced across 8 domains and request/report/proposal/simulation, on all three declared tokenizers. The proposal names 48 pairs; this prospective power-of-two expansion to 64 preserves domain and force balance and binary-exact means. Sixteen distinct slot/reference tuples each occur in four forces; these are not 64 independent naturally sampled scenarios. It does not test reader understanding, false extra inferences, validity fixtures, or adoption.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input token_delta replication of e2ff808e72df863f2c403344843ac1f8e81cd6ae3b55ed3150e05ff922de5842: preserve its stable-v2 complete-replacement grid, exact estimand, four ordered equal-weight force strata and three-tokenizer roster; calculate Ainglish-minus-careful-English mean per tokenizer and least-favourable maximum, with member-span interval and every force result under the headline tokenizer.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated suggestions still offer this exact modern source with no matching attempt
source remains valid, disputed at zero agreements/two disagreements, server-derivation-verified and fully recoverable
stable-v2 comparison identity, exact estimand, interval recipe, tokenizer roster and ordered equal-weight force strata are preserved
all 64 complete pairs and 128 individual arms have zero overlap with every recoverable valid token row
eight declared domains, two distinct new slot/reference tuples per domain and every request/report/proposal/simulation cell are retained
slot, force prefix, old reference and new reference bytes are exactly shared inside each pair
official attempt is minted before tokenizer import; direct, SDK and server derivations must agree
every finite agreement or disagreement is filed once without outcome selection or pair tuning
